title: Ended the 2nd week.
author: Zephyr_Labs
selftext:
This was by far the cleanest test week I have had out of the two.

The system runs completely autonomously now every day with no crashes 👌🏼

Seemed to stabilize near the end of the session and grabbed back about 1% of the days loss, so I’m betting Monday brings some additional stability.

We will see what Argus does next week!

comments.author: joshman1204
comments.body: Wow another bot on a paper account. Who cares.

replies.author: Zephyr_Labs
replies.body: Wow. Another anonymous hater. Piss off.

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body:
How exactly am I anonymous? Post history isn't hidden hell with a little effort I could easily be doxxed down to my home address. Part of owning a business. 

Agents running on paper are essentially worthless. Put at least a few dollars behind it then maybe somebody cares. Just a few hundred would be a totally different game. I get not everyone can trade larger accounts but anything is better than paper.

replies.author: Zephyr_Labs
replies.body:
So let me get this straight.

You have all this going for ya, and you choose to go a shit on someone online for what? 

Things not happy at home? 

Piss off and go irritate someone else. 

I couldn’t care less if you cared. 🖕🏼

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body:
You obviously care. The point still stands. Bots on paper accounts are basically worthless at this point. There are dozens of them posted here everyday with no actual details. Just a webpage built by codex with a bunch of shit that doesn't actually mean anything. 

If you feel someone pointing out the truth is shitting on you then so be it. I've made it where I am because a few people had the guts to tell me I was doing shit wrong. My best friend and biggest business mentor has also driven me absolutely crazy. We've had full on shouting cussing matches in the middle of the shop. He's the only person that ever had the balls to stand up to me and tell me I was wrong. Hes also still the first person I call. 

I've spent a shit load of money on agentic AI trading and I've seen a lot of people be led down a path by an optimistic and confident sounding so when the whole thing is just bullshit and nobody ever told them.

comments.author: sleeplong
comments.body:
The point the others are making is that you did not show any details, does not have to be super specific. But a method, your theory, a hypothesis? Nothing. All you can do is post a screenshot after one day. 

People seen this a million times here. Nothing special, in two days you have a loss and do not post here? 

Stop hating on people and give some actual input. Or keep it to yourself and be happy about the 1% :)

Good luck out there
